title: China Employment Watch
description: Track China’s labour market through official releases, historical coverage and experimental indicators.

dashboard.failure: Collection failed. The last verified snapshot is shown.
dashboard.invalid: Quality checks failed. The last verified snapshot is shown.
dashboard.official_explainer: Official monthly rates for urban China and for 31 major cities.
dashboard.pmi_explainer: Monthly survey measures for manufacturing and non-manufacturing. The reference line at 50 marks no change.
dashboard.index_explainer: Equal-weight average of the two PMI employment signals on a fixed robust scale. Experimental.
dashboard.unusual: Unusual changes flagged in the dataset
dashboard.method_baseline: The experimental demand index uses January 2023 through December 2024 as its frozen baseline. Each monthly PMI component is centered by its median and divided by 1.4826 × MAD before equal-weight averaging. Component scores are capped at ±5.
dashboard.method_shadow: The shadow index requires both comparable search data and the demand index for the same period. Official unemployment is an independent reference. Exam-search indicators are separate.
dashboard.method_validation: The PMI comparison uses rolling time-ordered validation. The shadow index lacks eligible test cases.

research.title: Multidimensional research
research.summary: Explore official industry surveys, property development and migrant-worker statistics alongside publication-aware model tests.
research.financial_pending: A-share index closes are unavailable pending licensed historical data and reuse rights.
research.evaluation_note: Expanding-window ridge and persistence on {n, number} shared test months, {first} – {last}. Errors in percentage points.
research.association_note: Pearson correlation of first reported levels for shared months. These are descriptive associations.

explain.construction-pmi: Monthly seasonally adjusted activity, orders and staffing. A value of 50 denotes no change.
explain.construction-annual: Sector value added and profits of qualified general and specialist contractors use different populations.
explain.property-growth: Official comparable-basis growth versus the same cumulative period a year earlier. January–February is a joint release.
explain.property-area: Official area from January through the period end. January–February is a joint release.
explain.property-amount: Official amounts from January through the period end. January–February is a joint release.
explain.migrant-count: National monitoring survey. Counts describe worker populations and mobility.
explain.migrant-industry: Annual employment shares in the survey population.
explain.migrant-income: Annual survey average of monthly earnings.
explain.manufacturing-pmi: Monthly seasonally adjusted production and new orders.
explain.services-pmi: Monthly seasonally adjusted activity, orders and staffing.
explain.sector-pressure: Equal-weight PMI employment scores for manufacturing, construction and services, with higher values indicating weaker staffing. Fixed 2023–2024 calibration.

series.migrant_urban: Living in urban areas at year end
